pr_title: add checks for optional properties of FPGA iCE40
pr_body:
Add checks in the GPIO bitbang mode to avoid a fault for missing configuration in the devicetree.
Fixes #80850
pr_comments: @benediktibk - I would fully support moving these checks to build-time if that works. It's possible that the build_all tests would need to have some arbitrary gpio present.
I'm planning on simplifying the usage of the iCE40 in #80846 and #80854 and would prefer to change these into build time check probably in #80854, as this hopefully simplifies the macros.

issue_context.title: load mode GPIO bitbang for iCE40 is broken
issue_context.body:
**Describe the bug**
Trying to load a bitstream into an iCE40 with the GPIO bitbang mode results in a MPU fault.

**To Reproduce**
1. select load mode GPIO bitbang in the devicetree: `load-mode = <1>;`
2. execute fpga_load on this instance
3. MPU fault

    <err> os: ***** MPU FAULT *****
    <err> os:   Data Access Violation
    <err> os:   MMFAR Address: 0x9f85fd3b
    <err> os: r0/a1:  0x00000000  r1/a2:  0x00000000  r2/a3:  0x000a0000
    <err> os: r3/a4:  0x000a0000 r12/ip:  0x000a0000 r14/lr:  0x08007d03
    <err> os:  xpsr:  0x41000000
    <err> os: Faulting instruction address (r15/pc): 0x08007cdc
    <err> os: >>> ZEPHYR FATAL ERROR 19: Unknown error on CPU 0
    <err> os: Current thread: 0x20021280 (unknown)
    <err> os: Halting system

The SPI mode is working just fine.

**Expected behavior**
It should be possible to use the GPIO bitbang load mode.

**Impact**
It is not possible to use the iCE40 in combination with low-end microcontrollers.


**Environment:**
- Zephyr: 23fb3b77a2b2cf53eff1697888f443236069b30c
- Hardware: nucleo_f767zi
comments:
@benediktibk - can you please provide additional reproduction details? E.g. board, sample, configuration, etc?

Are you attempting to run this from userspace?
What file / line of code is 0x08007c74? running addr2line should say

I did not intent to go that deep into this bug at this moment, as it is not bothering me. But as an answer to your question I've started the debugger, and this is the call stack:

    z_arm_usage_fault() at fault_s.S:80 0x8002530	
    <signal handler called>() at 0xfffffffd	
    z_impl_gpio_pin_configure() at gpio.h:1,011 0x8007c74	
    gpio_pin_configure() at gpio.h:62 0x8007c9a	
    gpio_pin_configure_dt() at gpio.h:1,031 0x8007c9a	
    fpga_ice40_load_gpio() at fpga_ice40.c:233 0x80033b6	
    fpga_ice40_load() at fpga_ice40.c:443 0x8007dac	
    fpga_load() at fpga.h:111 0x80004ee	
    main() at main.c:11 0x80004ee	

The cause for the fault is therefore the missing configuration of the additional GPIOs, e.g. clk-gpios. As these properties are not required I think a few null-checks would be reasonable.

review_comments:
It might be possible to move this check at build-time by removing the `_OR` from here:
https://github.com/zephyrproject-rtos/zephyr/blob/4bb945300bf92e4708404102d2a3b54e540bfd6c/drivers/fpga/fpga_ice40.c#L536

But it is still allowed to be empty for SPI, so it could be some build assert checking `FPGA_ICE40_LOAD_MODE(inst)` eventually.

A run-time check is good too!
